patch_description: The current approach can stop early when a selected neighborhood has no fresh moves, and its small, mostly fixed batches limit exploration of the 2,000-call budget. This version uses explicit fallback parents and kicks, keeps a bounded quality-and-diversity archive, and adapts parent selection and move exploration to stagnation. It evaluates up to three surrogate-ranked moves per round while reserving a slot for a less energy-favored move. Bottleneck links guide both two-switches and rotations; simulated-annealing acceptance lets the search move between basins rather than only following immediate improvements.
